notes:
Achievements with gamerscore ✿
• Trophies are now Xbox-style achievements: every achievement is worth gamerscore, and your profile shows your total G
• Platinums stay: 100% a game and it still gets its platinum, which also boosts your level
• Your level stays too, now built from your gamerscore plus your platinums
• WFC uses its real Xbox 360 gamerscore (1000G). Steam games get up to 1000G each, shared out by rarity, so rarer achievements are worth more; once given, the values stay put
• Friends: their level and gamerscore show in your friends list and on their profile
